Actually in D 11: environmental classes E (climatic), M (mechanical). M1 = humidity class? In D11: "E1/E2/E3" climatic, "M1/M2/M3" mechanical? Hmm. R137 says instrument environment class per ISO 4064? I'll just record environmental_class: "M1 / E2" as a string. Simpler: two entries "environmental_class_m" and "environmental_class_e"? Overcomplicating. I'll do environmental_classes: "M1 / E2".
